ndvi.tif.bands: monthly NDVI composites from product NDVI band, SummaryQA <= 1
ndvi.tif.limitations: MODIS is a coarser-resolution long-term baseline; quality filtering does not eliminate every atmospheric or compositing artefact.

used_for: dry-season window selection for Layer 4 when sar_months is null
rain.tif.limitations: Rainfall is a gridded estimate and may not represent local microclimates or irrigation.

vh.tif.bands: monthly median VH backscatter, descending IW acquisitions
vh.tif.units: dB backscatter; seasonal trend is relative VH dB/year after annual spatial-median adjustment
vh.tif.limitations: Backscatter also responds to moisture, surface roughness, geometry and acquisition conditions.

s2_ndvi.tif.bands: monthly median NDVI after SCL and QA60 cloud/cirrus masking
used_for: recent high-resolution visual preview and image-quality context
s2_ndvi.tif.limitations: This supplementary stack is not substituted for the MODIS long-term series in the four analytical layers.

important_note: NoData represents unavailable observations, not zero vegetation, zero rainfall or no degradation.
